_about: Landmarks placed by hand, in the master sheet's pixels (x right, y down), for what the sheet's colours cannot find: the paws, which the sheet draws with no line between paw and leg. Each point is the centre of the paw's rounded end: midway between its side outlines, and from the top of its toe lines to its sole. Placed on the sheet zoomed six to nine times with a 5 px grid; measure.py checks each one is inside the silhouette, and the overlays in ref/overlays show them all. The back view draws no paw: the haunches and the tail sit on the ground.

front._note: The front paws are the legs' rounded ends, side by side under the chest (sole y 279, toe lines from about y 267). The hind paws are the round ovals on each side, below the haunches' tan (y 257 to 275).

side.L._note: The near front paw (the dog's left) is the big one, x 669 to 711. The small paw ahead of it, sitting higher, is the far front paw (the dog's right): only its toe end shows, and the point is the centre of what shows. The near hind foot rests forward under the haunch, x 712 to 773. The far hind paw is hidden.

threeQuarter.L._note: The dog turns to its right, so its left side is near. The far front paw (the dog's right) is on the sheet's left, its sole higher (y 277); the near front paw is lower and larger (sole y 281); the near hind paw follows (x 1148 to 1195). The far hind paw is hidden.
